threads.body: [General] Keep the Quarkus Gradle plugin and platform BOM on the same release line. The 3.39.5 plugin is coupled to Quarkus build/bootstrap internals, while this resolves the application and deployment artifacts from 3.40.0; that cross-minor mix is unsupported and can break augmentation or produce an inconsistent application model. Use 3.39.5 for both here, or update both to 3.40.0 once that plugin version is available.
